# Top 100 Viral Hook Formulas

Battle-tested hook structures for short-form video, posts, threads, and headlines. Organized by 10 psychology triggers.

---

## Category 01 — Curiosity Gap

**Why it works:** The brain treats unanswered questions like open browser tabs. It can't relax until the gap closes — so the viewer keeps watching.

| ID | Formula | Example | Platform |
|----|---------|---------|----------|
| 001 | "Nobody talks about [unexpected thing] in [niche]" | "Nobody talks about why your Reels flop after 3am posts" | All |
| 002 | "I found out why [common problem] keeps happening" | "I found out why your followers never convert" | All |
| 003 | "The [niche] industry doesn't want you to know this" | "The skincare industry doesn't want you to know this" | TikTok / IG |
| 004 | "What happens when you [unexpected action] for [timeframe]" | "What happens when you post 3x a day for 90 days" | YouTube |
| 005 | "I've been [doing thing] wrong my entire life" | "I've been writing captions wrong my entire life" | All |
| 006 | "The truth about [topic] that nobody is saying" | "The truth about freelancing that nobody is saying" | All |
| 007 | "Why [common belief] is actually the opposite" | "Why 'eat less, move more' is actually making you fat" | All |
| 008 | "I wasn't supposed to share this, but…" | "I wasn't supposed to share this, but here's what big agencies charge" | TikTok / IG |
| 009 | "What I learned from [unusual source]" | "What I learned from a 70-year-old stripper about negotiation" | All |
| 010 | "The hidden cost of [popular thing]" | "The hidden cost of going remote that nobody mentions" | All |

---

## Category 02 — Contrarian / Pattern-Interrupt

**Why it works:** Contradicting a belief creates cognitive dissonance. People engage to resolve it — agree or argue, both feed the algorithm.

| ID | Formula | Example | Platform |
|----|---------|---------|----------|
| 011 | "Stop [common advice everyone gives]" | "Stop posting every day — here's what actually grows" | All |
| 012 | "[Popular strategy] is dead. Here's what replaced it" | "Hashtag research is dead. Here's what replaced it" | All |
| 013 | "Unpopular opinion: [bold claim about niche]" | "Unpopular opinion: Canva templates are killing your brand" | LinkedIn / X |
| 014 | "I quit [thing everyone does] and [positive result]" | "I quit posting Reels and my engagement doubled" | All |
| 015 | "Everyone's doing [trend] but they're missing [key detail]" | "Everyone's doing carousels but missing the last slide" | IG / LinkedIn |
| 016 | "[Common advice] is making things worse" | "More cardio is making your body fat worse" | All |
| 017 | "Hot take: [contrarian belief]" | "Hot take: most personal brands are just glorified resumes" | X / LinkedIn |
| 018 | "I'm done with [popular practice]" | "I'm done with growth hacking. Here's what I do now" | All |
| 019 | "If you're still doing [X], stop" | "If you're still cold-emailing the same way, stop" | All |
| 020 | "The opposite of [common advice] worked for me" | "The opposite of 'hustle' grew my business 5x" | All |

---

## Workflow tip

The two best hooks per video are usually from **different categories**. Mix one stop-scroll hook (negation, specificity, question) with one retention hook (story, confession, emotional). The first stops the thumb. The second keeps them watching past 3 seconds.
